summary: Executed targeted backend + frontend regression for responsive layouts, map, lead forms, WhatsApp queue/settings, Search Console kit, admin workflows, and streaming chat on the public preview URL.

critical.issue: Login response does not set any httpOnly cookie (token-only response). Auth playbook requirement failed.
Access-Control-Allow-Origin is not the app origin under test (returned cluster-5 emergentcf.cloud), so explicit-origin + credentials expectation failed.
After 5 invalid attempts, 6th attempt still returns 401 instead of 429 lockout.

minor.issue: Auth playbook reference file is missing in workspace, so full doc-driven auth checklist cannot be followed exactly.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal overflow at 320px on home and detail pages due hard min width; page scrollWidth=337 on 320 viewport.

integration_issues.issue: Intermittent failed fetch logs during first render (locations/freelancers/services/founder/map) before recovery; caused inconsistent UX in one run.

issues: React warning: unique key prop issue reported for WorldwideMap render.
Hydration warning: <span> inside <option> observed from Emergent overlay instrumentation; noisy but non-blocking for flows.

action_items: Implement cookie-based auth session support (httpOnly cookie) or align auth acceptance criteria and test expectations.
Fix CORS origin/credentials policy for the active preview origin and ensure deterministic preflight headers.
Fix brute-force lockout behavior to return 429 after 5 failed attempts (verify identifier consistency behind ingress/proxy).
Remove 320px overflow by replacing TrustGuarantees `min-w-[620px]` with responsive strategy (stacked/mobile table pattern).
Stabilize initial homepage fetch behavior to avoid recurring failed-fetch console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth route returns bearer token only; if cookie-based hardening is required, current implementation is incomplete.
CORS is currently permissive and not tied to explicit expected frontend origin in this environment.
TrustGuarantees uses a fixed min-width container that breaks strict mobile viewport requirements.
App has repeated console noise in normal browsing, reducing confidence in production observability.

success_rate.frontend: 88% (core flows pass; 320 overflow + console quality issues)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-style leads via API during tests; queue entries persisted as pending_setup/dismissed with attempts=0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key verified passes: /api/map/hubs(8), near-me London, WhatsApp settings/queue auth+validation+dismiss, search-console checklist persistence, sitemap health, chat stream start/delta/done, chat sessionStorage restore/reset isolation, enquiry form saves from detail+modal, project URL unverified labels for Amanpuri and zumarestaurants. Re-run responsive at 320 specifically for overflow regression.
rca of the issue: Auth lockout likely fails due identifier behavior under ingress (request.client.host variability/proxy context), so attempts never satisfy lockout condition for the same computed key. CORS mismatch indicates environment-origin negotiation not aligned with expected preview host. 320px overflow is directly caused by fixed `min-w-[620px]` in TrustGuarantees table wrapper, forcing document width > viewport.
